newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines Jan-Mar 1997 coconut exports lower.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Jan-Mar 1997 coconut exports lower.

text.p: Philippine coconut exports for the first quarter of 1997 fell 1.42 percent to $207.35 million against in the same period last year, the Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) said on Monday.
Exports volume was 11.5 percent lower at 339,297 tonnes from 383,504 a year-ago.
Coconut oil exports dropped 13.3 percent to 187,172 tonnes after 215,809 in the first quarter of 1996.
The value of coconut oil exports fell 6.5 percent at $140.73 million in the first quarter of the year compared with $150.58 million in the first three months of 1996.
The PCA said that coconut exports were lower due to the massive damage wrought by three typhoons in late 1995 which hit production.
